title: The Poor family in the lane
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：poor　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 poor 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the warden wrote of ① a poor family in the lane in the register, and everybody in the centre said at once that it was ② poorer than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the warden, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the poor ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the poorest family in the lane anybody in the centre had ever seen, or so the register for June 1980 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too poor to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the resident who had come to help; the poor ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a poor harvest of that year, and said that no resident in his right mind would call it ⑥ as poor as the harvest of that year they had once had in the old centre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was poor or not, and he said so.

By 1993 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something poor, and nothing besides. The resident from the next centre called the whole plan ⑧ quite poor; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the poor ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1996, for the whole place, she wrote of another poor family in the lane in the same register, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ poorer than anybody had expected. ⑩ The poorest harvest of that year in the whole centre, she said in 1998, was the one she could never quite name; the poor ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 贫穷（前置定语 a poor family in the lane：1986 年管理员在登记册里记下的那件贫穷的人家）
B. adj. 贫穷／差劲（比较级 poorer than：文中两处，一处比巷子里穷苦的人家，一处比预想）
C. adj. 贫穷／差劲（最高级 the poorest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 贫穷（表语 too poor to do：母亲觉得它太贫穷，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 差劲（前置定语 a poor harvest of that year：叔叔把整件事称作一桩差劲的庄稼）
F. adj. 差劲（同级比较 as poor as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩那年歉收的庄稼相比）
G. adj. 差劲（后置定语 something poor：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 差劲（受程度副词修饰 quite poor：那位居民的评价）

items.q: a poor family in the lane
the poorest family in the lane anybody
a poor harvest of that year
The poorest harvest of that year in

answers.why: poor 意为“贫穷”，1986 年管理员在登记册里记下的是“一件贫穷的人家”，此处作前置定语 a poor family in the lane。
poor 意为“贫穷”，此处用比较级 poorer than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
poor 意为“贫穷”，登记册上 六月 那行字说它是社区中心里最贫穷的一件，故用最高级 the poorest family in the lane。
poor 意为“贫穷”，母亲认为这件东西“太贫穷了，谁也用不上”，too poor to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
poor 意为“差劲”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩差劲的庄稼”，此处作前置定语 a poor harvest of that year。
poor 意为“差劲”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩那年歉收的庄稼一样差劲”，同级比较用 as poor as。
poor 意为“差劲”，登记册上那半行字要的是“差劲的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something poor。
poor 意为“差劲”，邻社区中心来的那位居民认为这套计划“相当差劲”，quite 修饰原级 poor。
poor 意为“差劲”，1996 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要差劲”，故用比较级 poorer than。
poor 意为“差劲”，母亲 1998 年说的是“整个社区中心里最差劲的那一桩”，故用最高级 the poorest harvest of that year。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1986 年，管理员在登记册里记下了一件贫穷的人家。（a poor family in the lane）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更贫穷。（poorer than …）
母亲觉得它太贫穷，谁也用不上。（too poor to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩差劲的庄稼。（a poor harvest of that year）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩那年歉收的庄稼一样差劲。（as poor as …）
到了 1993 年，登记册上只剩半行字：要的是一件差劲的东西。（something poor）
answers: In 1986 the warden wrote of a poor family in the lane in the register.
Everybody said it was poorer than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too poor to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a poor harvest of that year.
He said nobody would call it as poor as the harvest of that year they had once had.
By 1993 the register asked for nothing but something poor.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 poor 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1986 the warden wrote of a poor family in the lane in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the poorest family in the lane in the centre, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too poor to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a poor harvest of that year, and nobody argued with him.
The resident from the next centre called the plan quite poor, and everybody laughed.
The poor ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
